svg.title: Spatial imaging toolkit: end-to-end analysis architecture
svg.desc: The existing Streamlit app and separate cell-table analysis are distinguished from candidate modality processing and integration and future prediction. Pairing and alignment are required for cross-modal analysis. Galaxy is deferred.
svg.text: Spatial imaging toolkit · end-to-end architecture
Existing component
Candidate / proposed
Review / future
1 | PROJECT SETUP AND CURRENT EXECUTION
Inputs and project mapping
Images, modality metadata, sample / patient IDs, groups, biological units and pairing
Current private application and execution
Streamlit via SSH tunnel · adapters · SLURM workers on allocated HPC resources
Map available inputs to modality-specific candidates; review QC before downstream use.
2 | MODALITY PROCESSING AND REVIEWED QC
CycIF
Multiplex imaging
MCMICRO (preferred candidate): illumination / stitching → Mesmer segmentation (preferred)
Quantify markers and image features; select suitable inputs and inspect segmentation
Reviewed QC
images + cell features
Hyperspectral
Spectral imaging
Spectral QC and calibration → spectral phasors or unmixing
Use suitable reference / calibration data; validate chosen method
Reviewed QC
FLIM
Lifetime imaging
Raw QC and calibration → PhasorPy or FLIMfit candidate
Appropriate lifetime inputs and calibration references required
Reviewed QC
H&E
Histology
QuPath candidate → tissue annotation / image features
Role and measurements depend on study design
Reviewed QC
Required pairing + alignment
VALIS candidate; validate registration
Spatial data and cell / feature tables
Coordinates, sample IDs, measurements and QC; aligned for cross-modal use
Cross-modal analysis requires pairing and alignment; independent modality analysis can bypass alignment. Check registration quality.
3 | BIOLOGICAL ANALYSIS AND MULTIMODAL INTEGRATION
Existing separate cell-table analysis
Cell classification and program scores
Per-core / biological-unit summaries; descriptive spatial features
Exploratory selected-pair spatial null; group comparisons
Requires suitable cell tables; not an automatic end-to-end workflow
Candidate downstream biological analysis
SCIMAP / Squidpy: phenotypes, neighborhoods, spatial analysis
Group comparisons at the biological-unit level
Vitessce / Napari: tissue maps and linked visual review
Study-specific methods and validation; account for biological replication
Candidate multimodal integration · requires paired and aligned data
CORAL: aligned multiscale spatial molecular data | SpatialGlue: matched observations / spatial modalities
MOFA+: shared multimodal factors with appropriately matched samples and suitable feature matrices
Candidates, not interchangeable; none is established here as a BODIPY prediction method.
4 | FUTURE PREDICTION AND REPORTING
Future supervised prediction · separate from integration
BODIPY-derived features → measured H&E / CycIF targets, with matched samples and ground-truth measurements
Train and evaluate on held-out biological units; avoid leakage across images / regions from the same unit.
Results, QC and provenance report
Figures and biological summaries · QC / alignment review · sample mapping and biological units
Record methods, versions, parameters, inputs, exclusions and limitations.
